LESSON: ORAL HYGIENE PRACTICES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Health
Topic 1.2: Oral hygiene practices

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Oral hygiene practices. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Oral hygiene practices.
2. Explain Oral hygiene practices to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Oral hygiene practices.
4. Show that you can: name common problems related to teeth,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Oral hygiene practices. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Oral hygiene practices important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
